workflow.name: Hon Dolo - Image Refinement SDXL v001

adaptation: Removed EmptyLatentImage; LoadImage -> Lanczos resize -> VAEEncode now supplies KSampler.latent_image.
Selected live Cloud Juggernaut XL v9 checkpoint instead of source-template SDXL base or the tutorial's Juggernaut X.
Matching checkpoint VAE feeds both VAEEncode and VAEDecode.
Positive/negative text remains visible on native CLIPTextEncode nodes; negative is connected and initially empty.
Added connected denoise scalar default 0.30 and resized-source preview; SaveImage previews/preserves result.
Removed stale widgets_values_named fields from the source template. Version1 exposed a mismatch during compiled-input review; version2 corrected it before any render.

input.role: Grok styling template with placeholder identity, not an accepted likeness master

settings.positive_prompt: Photorealistic studio portrait of an adult man with wavy dark brown hair, natural facial proportions, black open-collar shirt, heavy gold chain, gold grill, face and neck tattoos, gray studio background. Soft balanced studio lighting, realistic skin pores, believable fabric and metal texture, confident expression.

validation.limits: Dry run validates structure against the tool catalog and is not an executed Cloud generation or visual-quality test.

limitations: Single input, whole-image SDXL refinement: no second likeness reference, mask, face adapter, ControlNet or temporal video control.
Denoise0.30 is an exploratory starting setting, not a preservation percentage or validated quality optimum.
Faces, tattoo text, teeth and jewelry may change even at low denoise.
Resize is ordinary interpolation; no learned super-resolution or 4K finishing is included.
No LoRA is enabled. Any later adapter must be compatible with SDXL; the Klein Candid Film adapter is not used here.
The main Klein editor remains the reference-likeness route; its saved graph and the existing comparison/input-check recipes were not modified.

usage.note: No generation submitted during preparation. Running the recipe may accrue Comfy Cloud runtime.
